_meta: A stream of requests arriving at a service that calls two downstream dependencies, A and B, sharing one pool of concurrency slots (threads, connections). Dependency A has gone slow -- each call holds its slot for 10 ticks. Dependency B is healthy -- each call holds its slot for 1 tick. total_slots is the size of the shared pool; bulkhead_caps is the per-dependency cap when the pool is partitioned into bulkheads. The scenario: four A calls arrive at once and, in a shared pool, occupy every slot for 10 ticks, so the healthy B calls that arrive next find no free slot and are rejected -- A's saturation starves an unrelated, healthy dependency. A bulkhead caps each dependency to its own share of the pool, so A can only exhaust its own partition and B always has slots. requests is the ordered fixture of (id, arrival, dep, service); every admit/reject outcome is computed by the simulation.
